pc.name: Daruuro dhibic
pc.privacy: Faylka iyo daruurta waligood kombuutarkan kama baxaan. Faylka halkan ayaa la akhrinayaa, jajabyada waxaa lagu kaydiyaa kaydka gudaha ee browserkan; wax lagu soo rarayo ma jiro.
pc.numbers: Wixii tabkan soo sheegaa waa tiro ka timid xogtaada, ma aha shahaado. Xirfadlaha diiwaangashan ayaa go'aamiya waxa ay ku fiican tahay.
pc.stopped: Waa la joojiyay. Dhismuhu wixii dhammeeyay ayuu hayaa; riix Sii wad si aad u sii waddo.
pc.info.need: Dhismuhu wuxuu u baahan yahay ku dhowaad
pc.info.short: Dhismuhu wuxuu u baahan yahay ku dhow {need}, browserkanina wuxuu kaydin karaa {free}. Meel bannaan samee ama isticmaal fayl yar.
pc.progress.merge: Heerarka qaro weyn la isku xidhayo
pc.list.empty: Weli daruuro ma jiraan. Sare ka fur fayl.
pc.list.resume.hint: Isla faylkii hore mar kale dooro, kadibna riix Sii wad.
pc.remove.title: Daruurtan ma ka saarno?
pc.remove.body: {name} waxaa laga saarayaa kaydka browserkan. Faylka aad furtay lama taabanayo.
pc.budget: Dhibcaha ugu badan ee la sawiro
pc.stats: {drawn} ka mid ah ugu badnaan {budget} dhibic ayaa la sawiray · {nodes} jaj ayaa la muujiyay, {loading} sugaya · {mb} MB ayaa lagu hayaa
pc.clean.hint: Qorshaha ku sawir qaab, ama aragga 3D ee muuqaalka sare ka bilow. 3D-ga qaabka waxaa lagu dhex dhigaa heer toosan, markaasna waxay doorataa tiir toosan. Tirada hoose waxay muujinaysaa ka hor inta aan wax la beddelin.
pc.clean.draw.lasso: Riix, dhibcaha ku wareeji, sii dayn. Esc waa jooja.
pc.clean.draw.box: Riix geesta hal, ku jiid geesta ka soo horjeeda, sii dayn. Esc waa jooja.
pc.clean.draw.polygon: Geeska riix; laba jeer riix ama Enter ku xir. Esc waa jooja.
pc.clean.count: {n} ka mid ah {total} dhibic ayaa gudaha ku jira
pc.act.crop: Ka jar xadkan (tirtir wixii dibadda ku jira)
pc.label.restore: Dhibcihii gudaha qaabka ayaa la soo celiyay
pc.label.crop: Xadka ayaa laga jaray ({n} dhibic ayaa la saaray)
pc.big.title: Taasi waa ka badan badh daruurta
pc.big.body: Tanu waxay beddelaysaa {n} dhibic, {pct} % daruurta. Dib ayaa loo noqon karaa. Sii wadaa?
pc.log.title: Wax ka beddelka ilaa hadda (faylka lafteeda ma beddelmo)
pc.noise.title: Hel buuqa
pc.noise.what: Dhibcaha u fog-fog ah waxay calaamadeeyaan sida dhibic hoose (fasal 7) ama buuq sare (fasal 18). Ma jiro wax la tirtirayo haddaan sanduuqa calaamad saarin. Hal tallaabo oo ka noqod.
pc.noise.radius.hint: Midabka faylka. Dhibcaha ayaa loo tirinayaa deriska inta ka soo baxda masaafadan.
pc.noise.min.hint: Go'an: dhibic deriska ka yar tan waa buuq.
pc.noise.k.hint: Tirakoob: celceliska masaafada dhibcaha ugu dhow ee tiradan.
pc.noise.sd.hint: Tirakoob: wax ka fog celceliska iyo tirada kan ayaa buuq ah.
pc.noise.remove: Sidoo kale tirtir dhibcaha la helay
pc.noise.done: {n} dhibic ayaa la calaamadeeyay ({low} hoose, {high} sare) {ms} ms gudahood.
pc.g.what: Dhulka jaj ahaan ayuu helaa (jajabyo 256 m oo isku dhex jira), dhibic walba ayuu la barbardhigaa, oo dhul (fasal 2) iyo dhibcaha hoose (fasal 7) ayuu calaamadeeyaa. Hal tallaabo oo ka noqod.
pc.g.cell.hint: Cabbirka shabakadda raadinta dhibcaha ugu hoose, midabka faylka.
pc.g.tol.hint: Dhibic u dhow dhulka la helay waxaa loo yaqaanaa dhul.
pc.g.slope.hint: Dhulka ugu janjeeraha ee shaandhuhu raacaya (kor u kacid ka dhex dhaadhac).
pc.g.obj.hint: Dhismayaasha ballaadhkoodu ka weyn yahay unugyada tiradan waa laga saaraa dhulka.
pc.g.start.file: fasalada hore ee faylka ku jira
pc.g.label: Kala-saarista dhulka
pc.c.label: Fasalada dhirta iyo dhismayaasha
pc.g.done: Dhul: {ground} dhibic, dhibcaha hoose: {noise}, {tiles} jaj, {ms} ms.
pc.g.seams: {n} xadka jajabyada ayaa ka duwan wax ka badan badh dulqaadka. Ka eeg intaas ka hor inta aadan dhulka halkaas isku halayn.
pc.g.seams.none: Ma jiro xad jajab oo ka duwan wax ka badan badh dulqaadka.
pc.c.done: Dhir hoose {low}, dhexe {mid}, sare {high}, dhismayaasha {building} ({ms} ms).
pc.s.what: Dhulka jira wuxuu ka dhisayaa dhibcaha loo yaqaan dhul, kadibna dhibcahaas ayuu la barbardhigaa. Dhulka waxaa lagu daraa mashruuca siyaabta LAS import-ku ku daro (dhibcaha loo sheegay GROUND), hal tallaabo oo ka noqod.
pc.s.maxedge: Geesta saddexagalka ugu dheer (0 = xad la'aan)
pc.s.maxedge.hint: Saddexagalada geesihooda ka dheer waa la reebaa, tusaale ahaan biyaha dushooda.
pc.s.done: {seen} dhibic dhul ah ka mid ah {kept} ayaa la isticmaalay; {points} dhibic ayaa lagu daray mashruuca, {tris} saddexagal.
pc.s.capped: Xadka dhibcaha ayaa la gaadhay; dhibcaha dhulka qaarkood waa la reebay.
pc.r.honest: Kuwani waa tirooyin daruurtan iyo dhulkan loogu talagalay. Ma aha shahaado wax kasta.
pc.r.worst: Tobanka meelood ee ugu kala duwan (riix si aad halkaas ugu aado)
pc.bl.title: Khadadka jebinta
pc.bl.hint: Aragga 3D, dhibcaha ku riix darbiga, tuulada ama sare ee kayd. Riix kasta waxay qaadaa dhibicda ugu dhow ee la sawiray.
pc.bl.saved: Khadka jebinta waa la kaydiyay; Dhis dhulka xiga ayaa isticmaali doona.
pc.c.none: Weli khadadka heerka ma jiraan. Marka hore dhulka dhis.
pc.v.title: Mugga kaydka
pc.v.what: Mugga dusha ka sarreeya saldhig gudaha xad aad sawirto. Xaddu waa inuu ku wareegaa kaydka dhulka.
pc.v.draw: Geeska riix oo kaydka ku wareeji; laba jeer riix ama Enter ku xir.
pc.v.leaves: Xadku xogta ka baxay: {area} unugyo labajibbaaran ma leh dusha, lamana tirinayo.
pc.f.open: Mugga laba duulimaad inta u dhexeysa…
pc.f.title: Mugga inta u dhexeysa laba duulimaad
pc.f.what: Dhulka {a} iyo daruurta kale ayuu dhisaa oo isku barbardhigaa. Buuxinta waa meesha duulimaadka kale uu ka sareeyo, goynta waa meesha uu ka hooseeyo.
pc.f.none: Marka hore daruuro labaad dhis. Halkan ayay ka soo muuqanaysaa liistada.
pc.x.title: Dhoofi fayl LAS 1.4 oo la nadiifiyay
pc.x.what: Daruurta wax ka beddelkaaga iyo fasalladaada oo lagu dabaqay ayuu u qoraa fayl LAS 1.4 cusub. Faylka asalka ah ma beddelmo. Wax-soo-saarka LAZ ma jiro.
pc.x.all: Dhibcaha oo dhan ee aan la tirtirin
pc.x.clean: Iyada oo aan fasalada buuqa lahayn
pc.sec.what: Khad ku sawir jaad, tuulo ama kayd: dhibcaha ku jira badhaxda ballaadhkiisa waxaa lagu sawiraa masaafada iyo dhererka.
pc.sec.draw: Bilowga riix, kadibna dhammaadka khadka riix.
pc.sec.out: {n} dhibic, khadka {len} dhererka, suunka {w} ballaadhka, dherarka {z0} ilaa {z1}.
pc.sec.tin: Khadka buluugga ahi waa dhulka aad dhistay.
pc.err.bad_cloud: Faylalka daruurtaas waa dhaawacan yihiin ama nooc kale ka yimid.
pc.err.building: Daruurtaas lama dhammayn. Faylka mar kale dooro oo riix Sii wad.
pc.err.missing_node: Jaj ka mid ah daruurta kaydka ma jiro.
pc.err.no_opfs: Browserkan kaydin uma haysto oo kordhintu isticmaali karto.
pc.err.bad_source: Faylkaas ma aha LAS ama LAZ uu kordhintu akhrin karto.
pc.err.too_few_points: Dhibcaha dhulka ee ugu yar ma jiraan si loo sameeyo dusha. Marka hore dhulka hel.
pc.err.no_surface: Dhibcahaas ma jiro dusha lagu samayn karo.
pc.err.no_ground: Tan waxay u baahan tahay in dhulka marka hore la helo.
pc.err.resume_mismatch: Taasi ma aha faylkii dhismuhu ku bilaabmay.
pc.err.too_many_cells: Tanu wuxuu weydiinayaa unugyo badan. Isticmaal cabbir unug weyn.
pc.err.no_overlap: Labada dhul ma isku dhex jiraan.
pc.err.not_configured: Kordhinta si sax ah looma dejin.
pc.err.bad_params: Mid ka mid ah dejinta lama isticmaali karo.
